Our story

Food is my secret meal, and only love.

A small, pure-veg cafe built for chai runs, late-night cravings and hanging out with friends — fresh taste, honest prices.

The vibe

Fairy lights, folding chairs, good company.

Our outdoor seating lights up every evening — plastic chairs, string lights overhead, and a plate of hot fries. No frills, just the right setting to hang out after a long day.
